items.source: Atomically returns and removes the first/last element (head/tail depending on the from argument) of the list stored at sourceKey, and pushes the element at the first/last element (head/tail depending on the to argument) of the list stored at destinationKey.
items.translation: 原子性地返回并移除存储在 `sourceKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `from` 参数是 head/tail），并将存储在 `destinationKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `to` 参数是 head/tail）推入该列表。

items.source: ReactiveRedisConnection.CommandResponse implementation for ByteBuffer responses for absent keys.
items.translation: ReactiveRedisConnection.CommandResponse 针对缺失键的 ByteBuffer 响应实现的类。

items.source: Remove the last element from list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey(), append it to ReactiveListCommands.BRPopLPushCommand.getDestination() and return its value.
items.translation: 从 ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey() 的列表中移除最后一个元素，将其追加到 ReactiveListCommands.BRPopLPushCommand.getDestination()，并返回其值。

items.source: Get element at ReactiveListCommands.LIndexCommand.getIndex() form list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 获取列表中的元素，该列表位于ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处，索引由ReactiveListCommands.LIndexCommand.getIndex()提供。

items.source: Remove the last element from list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey(), append it to ReactiveListCommands.RPopLPushCommand.getDestination() and return its value.
items.translation: 从 ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey() 中的列表移除最后一个元素，将其追加到 ReactiveListCommands.RPopLPushCommand.getDestination()，并返回其值。

items.source: Return the value at key and expire the key by applying Expiration.
items.translation: 返回 `key` 的值，并通过应用Expiration使该键过期。

items.source: Removes and returns last element in list stored at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 移除并返回存储在ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()中的列表的最后一个元素。

items.source: Set each and every item separately by invoking ReactiveStringCommands.SetCommand.
items.translation: 请分别调用ReactiveStringCommands.SetCommand来设置每一项。

items.source: Remove and return a random member from set at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 从集合中移除并返回一个随机成员，该集合位于ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()。

items.source: Return the value at key and delete the key.
items.translation: 返回 `key` 的值并删除该键。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Get a substring of value of key between start and end.
items.translation: 获取键值在 start 和 end 之间的子字符串。

items.source: Set value for key and return the existing value one by one.
items.translation: 为键设置值并逐个返回现有值。
